age_calculation.name: Age Calculation
age_calculation.description: Calculates the subject's age at the time of the baseline visit.

bmi.name: Body Mass Index (BMI)
bmi.description: A measure of body fat based on height and weight.

bsa_mosteller.name: Body Surface Area (Mosteller Formula)
bsa_mosteller.description: Calculates the total surface area of the human body, often used for indexing cardiac measurements.

waist_hip_ratio.name: Waist-to-Hip Ratio (WHR)
waist_hip_ratio.description: A measure of body fat distribution and an indicator of health risk.

egfr_ckd_epi_2021.name: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (CKD-EPI 2021)
egfr_ckd_epi_2021.description: Estimates kidney function based on serum creatinine, age, and sex. This is the formula used to calculate the GFR variable.
egfr_ckd_epi_2021.expression: 142 * min(Creatinine/κ, 1)^α * max(Creatinine/κ, 1)^-1.200 * 0.9938^Age * (1.012 if Female). [κ and α are constants dependent on sex and creatinine value]

homa_ir.name: Homeostatic Model Assessment for Insulin Resistance (HOMA-IR)
homa_ir.description: A method used to quantify insulin resistance and beta-cell function.

fib_4_score.name: Fibrosis-4 (FIB-4) Index for Liver Fibrosis
fib_4_score.description: A non-invasive score to estimate the degree of liver fibrosis in patients with liver disease.

de_ritis_ratio.name: De Ritis Ratio (AST/ALT)
de_ritis_ratio.description: The ratio of Aspartate Aminotransferase (AST) to Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT). It can be used in the diagnosis of certain liver diseases.

friedewald_ldlc.name: LDL Cholesterol (Friedewald Formula)
friedewald_ldlc.description: An estimation of Low-Density Lipoprotein cholesterol. It is generally valid when Triglycerides are below 4.5 mmol/L.

non_hdl_cholesterol.name: Non-HDL Cholesterol
non_hdl_cholesterol.description: Calculates the total cholesterol minus the high-density lipoprotein cholesterol, representing all atherogenic lipoprotein particles.

map.name: Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP)
map.description: The average arterial pressure throughout one cardiac cycle, systole, and diastole.
map.expression: MAP = Diastolic blood pressure + 1/3 * (Systolic blood pressure - Diastolic blood pressure)

pulse_pressure.name: Pulse Pressure (PP)
pulse_pressure.description: The difference between systolic and diastolic blood pressure.
pulse_pressure.expression: PP = Systolic blood pressure - Diastolic blood pressure

ejection_fraction_from_volumes.name: Ejection Fraction (from Volumes)
ejection_fraction_from_volumes.description: Calculates the percentage of blood leaving the left ventricle with each contraction, based on end-diastolic and end-systolic volumes.

stroke_volume_from_volumes.name: Stroke Volume (from Volumes)
stroke_volume_from_volumes.description: The volume of blood pumped from the left ventricle per beat.

stroke_volume_from_lvot.name: Stroke Volume (from LVOT)
stroke_volume_from_lvot.description: Calculates stroke volume using the Left Ventricular Outflow Tract (LVOT) diameter and Velocity Time Integral (VTI).

cardiac_output_from_lvot.name: Cardiac Output (from LVOT)
cardiac_output_from_lvot.description: Calculates the volume of blood the heart pumps per minute using the LVOT method.
cardiac_output_from_lvot.expression: CO (L/min) = (Stroke Volume from LVOT (mL) * Heart rate) / 1000

e_e_prime_ratio.name: E/e' Ratio (Diastolic Function)
e_e_prime_ratio.description: A key echocardiographic measure for estimating LV filling pressures. An average of septal and lateral e' is typically used.

lavi.name: Left Atrial Volume Index (LAVI)
lavi.description: Left atrial volume indexed to body surface area (BSA) to assess left atrial size.

lvm_ase.name: Left Ventricular Mass (ASE formula)
lvm_ase.description: Calculates the mass of the left ventricle using a linear method recommended by the American Society of Echocardiography (ASE).

rwt.name: Relative Wall Thickness (RWT)
rwt.description: A measure used to classify the pattern of left ventricular hypertrophy.

h2f_pef_score.name: H2F-PEF Score for HFpEF Diagnosis
h2f_pef_score.description: A clinical score to estimate the probability of Heart Failure with Preserved Ejection Fraction (HFpEF).
h2f_pef_score.expression: Points-based score: BMI > 30 (2 pts), Using >=2 antihypertensives (1 pt), Atrial Fibrillation (3 pts), Age > 60 (1 pt), E/e' ratio > 9 (1 pt), Estimated PASP (from TR Vmax) > 35 mmHg (1 pt).

cholesterol_mmol_to_g.name: Cholesterol Unit Conversion (mmol/L to g/L)
cholesterol_mmol_to_g.description: Converts total cholesterol from mmol/L to g/L.

hdl_mmol_to_g.name: HDL Cholesterol Unit Conversion (mmol/L to g/L)
hdl_mmol_to_g.description: Converts HDL cholesterol from mmol/L to g/L.

ldl_mmol_to_g.name: LDL Cholesterol Unit Conversion (mmol/L to g/L)
ldl_mmol_to_g.description: Converts LDL cholesterol from mmol/L to g/L.

triglycerides_mmol_to_g.name: Triglycerides Unit Conversion (mmol/L to g/L)
triglycerides_mmol_to_g.description: Converts triglycerides from mmol/L to g/L.
